acceptanceCriteria: All workspace package versions and current release documentation identify v0.2.93 consistently.
The reviewed and synchronized main commit is the sole immutable source identity for the v0.2.93 tag.
Candidate fresh install and candidate v0.2.92 to v0.2.93 upgrade pass in independent isolated environments.
Public v0.2.93 fresh install, v0.2.92 upgrade, manifest, checksum, and version consistency acceptance pass using downloaded Release assets.
Failed phases retain structured evidence and recovery reuses only identity-compatible successful phases.
goal: Advance the package from v0.2.92 to v0.2.93, preserve release identity and evidence boundaries, and complete candidate/public installation and N-1 upgrade acceptance before close.
intent: Publish the next AI Cockpit release from a reviewed synchronized main commit and prove public artifact adoption.
outOfScope: Rust behavior changes unrelated to versioning
provider Release or tag mutation before all pre-publication gates pass
local source checkout as a substitute for public artifact acceptance

scenarioCoverage.expected: The package metadata, release documentation, architecture versioning, and artifact naming consistently identify v0.2.93 while preserving v0.2.92 as N-1.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run version_consistency.sh and inspect all tri-language release and versioning projections.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Candidate fresh installation and v0.2.92 to v0.2.93 upgrade run in independent isolated environments and retain structured receipts.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect release workflow dependency graph and run candidate acceptance jobs.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Public v0.2.93 downloaded Release assets pass fresh install, N-1 upgrade, manifest, checksum, and version consistency acceptance.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the public acceptance jobs after publication and verify downloaded immutable assets.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A failed release phase preserves structured identity-bound evidence and recovery reruns only missing or identity-invalid phases.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run release workflow policy tests and inspect failure/recovery job dependencies and receipts.
